body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Duracell presented its new instant charger during Showstoppers at CES 2010, which is up to 35 hours of backup power and able to reserve power for most cell phones and recharged hundreds of times.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
